title: chip-chop states catalog
description: Catalog of every capturable UI state of an app, stored at <app>/.chipchop/states.yaml. A state is a route plus an optional overlay (modal, drawer, tab) plus a data scenario.

target.description: How to find an element. Prefer role+name: it survives CSS refactors.

kind.description: page: reachable by URL. modal/drawer/tab/state: reached by interacting with another state.

route.description: Route of the page, or of the page the overlay opens over. Hash routes (AngularJS) are written as /#!/login.

opensFrom.description: For non-page kinds: the state that must be active first.

via.description: Steps from opensFrom to reach this state. Same vocabulary as flow steps.

mocks.description: Mock ids loaded before the state is captured.

ready.description: Override of the default readiness rule.

mask.description: Regions painted over before the pixel diff (clocks, avatars, charts with random data).

viewports.description: Subset of config viewports. Omit for all.

source.description: Where in the source code this state is defined. Lets the AI keep the catalog in sync.
